title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Atuação com desenvolvimento Java (versões mais atuais).
  • Experiência com ecossistema SpringBoot .
  • Necessário conhecimento AWS Services (ECS, EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda, Kafka, DynamoDB ou similar, CI/CD, entre outros).
  • Experiência com testes utilizando JUnit, Mockito, entre outros...
  • Familiaridade com estrutura de microsserviços .
  • Desejável conhecimento em ambiente financeiro, PIX e/ou cobrança .

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

  • Atuação com desenvolvimento Java (versões mais atuais).
  • Experiência com ecossistema SpringBoot .
  • Necessário conhecimento AWS Services (ECS, EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda, Kafka, DynamoDB ou similar, CI/CD, entre outros).
  • Experiência com testes utilizando JUnit, Mockito, entre outros...
  • Familiaridade com estrutura de microsserviços .
  • Desejável conhecimento em ambiente financeiro, PIX e/ou cobrança .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (8+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Descrição da Empresa:


A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente e Qualificar leads em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas consultivas;
  • Realizar reuniões virtuais para apresentar nossas soluções;
  • Negociar com empresas para gerar uma nova venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes estratégicos da carteira, aconselhando as reuniões realizadas para gerar oportunidades de negócios futuros;
  • Fornecer, acompanhar e entregar as documentações possíveis para fechamento da venda (contratos e outros documentos);
  • Acompanhar a ativação desses novos clientes convertidos, garantindo a efetividade da venda feita;
  • Participar de reuniões internas para colaborar com estratégias e alavancar resultados


O que buscamos no seu perfil

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei profissional de desenvolvimento, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



- O que você deve ter?


  • Atuação com desenvolvimento Java (versões mais atuais).
  • Experiência com ecossistema SpringBoot .
  • Necessário conhecimento AWS Services (ECS, EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda, Kafka, DynamoDB ou similar, CI/CD, entre outros).
  • Experiência com testes utilizando JUnit, Mockito, entre outros...
  • Familiaridade com estrutura de microsserviços .
  • Desejável conhecimento em ambiente financeiro, PIX e/ou cobrança .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Designer gráfico freelancer
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa profissional para integrar nosso time, atuando em iniciativas criativas e de inovação, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções de design que apoiem objetivos de negócio e comunicação em diferentes canais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você será responsável por:

  • Criar e entregar materiais de design para apoiar iniciativas de marketing, comunicação e produtos digitais
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para compreender necessidades de negócio e traduzi-las em soluções visuais
  • Garantir consistência com diretrizes de marca, padrões visuais e sistemas de design
  • Gerenciar múltiplas demandas de design, assegurando qualidade e cumprimento de prazos
  • Manter documentação relacionada a processos, padrões e componentes de design
  • Participar de reuniões de projeto, revisões e rituais do time
  • Comunicar status, riscos e dependências para as partes interessadas

Requisitos e qualificações

Para essa posição é importante que você tenha:

  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas a design
  • Sólidos fundamentos de design visual (tipografia, cor, composição e layout)
  • Experiência com entregáveis digitais e/ou de marketing
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes colaborativos e ágeis
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Organização e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas prioridades
  • Inglês avançado


Seria legal se você tivesse:

  • Experiência com sistemas de design ou diretrizes de marca
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas modernas de design e colaboração
  • Vivência em times globais ou multidisciplinares
  • Conhecimento de produtos digitais, marketing ou ambientes de tecnologia

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (8+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Cientista de Dados - Sênior
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Cientista de Dados - Sênior



Resumo: Atuar como referência técnica e analítica na estruturação, evolução e confiabilidade dos dados de Ad Intelligence, transformando grandes volumes de dados complexos em insights estratégicos que apoiem decisões de negócio, desenvolvimento de produto e melhoria contínua dos processos operacionais. O cargo combina excelência técnica em Data Science com forte entendimento de mídia, metodologia e negócio, atuando como elo entre Dados, Produto, Operações e áreas comerciais, garantindo que o dado seja consistente, confiável, relevante e acionável para o mercado.



Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar, desenvolver e evoluir metodologias analíticas e modelos de dados aplicados aos produtos de Ad Intelligence, assegurando consistência, robustez e aderência às necessidades do mercado.
  • Conduzir análises aprofundadas de dados para identificar padrões, tendências, anomalias, riscos metodológicos e oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos, processos e entregas.
  • Desenvolver e testar hipóteses de negócio por meio de abordagens quantitativas, apoiando decisões estratégicas e táticas.
  • Atuar como consultor interno para as áreas de Produto, Operações, Taxonomia, Comercial e Liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis.
  • Automatizar análises, relatórios e fluxos de dados, aumentando eficiência operacional, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar continuamente a qualidade, cobertura e consistência dos dados, identificando e investigando desvios, gaps e comportamentos atípicos.
  • Contribuir para a evolução do conhecimento analítico e metodológico da empresa, por meio de documentação, treinamentos, apresentações e troca ativa com outros times.
  • Participar de interações com clientes e fornecedores quando necessário, explicando metodologias, análises e implicações dos dados de forma clara e transparente.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências em mídia, digital, cross-media, Data Science e Analytics, propondo inovações aplicáveis ao contexto da Kantar.



Conhecimento Essencial:

  • Forte experiência em análise de dados, modelagem estatística e Data Science.
  • Domínio de Python e/ou R e SQL.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e pipelines analíticos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e vice-versa.
  • Comunicação clara, didática e colaborativa.



Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Conhecimento de ambientes de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento específico de mídia digital, cross-media, CTV, VOD.
  • Entendimento de mídia, publicidade e métricas de investimento (ou capacidade de aprender rapidamente).
  • Conhecimento de banco relacional e databricks.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Descrição da Empresa:


A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente e Qualificar leads em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir o processo de vendas consultivas;
  • Realizar reuniões virtuais para apresentar nossas soluções;
  • Negociar com empresas para gerar uma nova venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes estratégicos da carteira, aconselhando as reuniões realizadas para gerar oportunidades de negócios futuros;
  • Fornecer, acompanhar e entregar as documentações possíveis para fechamento da venda (contratos e outros documentos);
  • Acompanhar a ativação desses novos clientes convertidos, garantindo a efetividade da venda feita;
  • Participar de reuniões internas para colaborar com estratégias e alavancar resultados


O que buscamos no seu perfil

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Proatividade e organização
  • Experiência em vendas de Serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas SaaS B2B
  • Experiência em Prospecção Ativa em diversos canais 
  • Atuação prévia com vendas Outbound


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologia de vendas;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com gestão do tempo;
  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas digitais (planilhas, e-mail, CRM etc.);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto de segunda à sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Comissionamento
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro de uma empresa em forte expansão.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com grande potencial de aprendizado.

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Java Senior
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

● Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações Java/Web, seguindo boas práticas e

padrões de arquitetura.

● Projetar e implementar camadas de persistência utilizando Hibernate e JPA.

● Criar e otimizar consultas e procedimentos em banco de dados Oracle.

● Escrever e manter testes unitários, de integração e performance.

● Participar ativamente das cerimônias e processos ágeis (planning, dailies,

reviews, retrospectivas).

● Participar de revisões de código e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos

processos.

● Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (QA, DevOps, Product) para

entregar soluções alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.

● Identificar e resolver gargalos de performance e problemas complexos em

produção.

● Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou

áreas correlatas.

● Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software com Java.

● Experiência sólida com frameworks de persistência: Hibernate e JPA.

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (8+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a \"degen\" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (8+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: COORDENADOR DE ENGENHARIA LOGÍSTICA
description:
A CAMACO é uma das maiores fornecedoras independente de soluções projetadas de estruturas metálicas de bancos automotivos e componentes, atuando globalmente, a empresa se orgulha de combinar engenharia avançada, experiência, solidez financeira e pessoas talentosas, para oferecer aos fabricantes de veículos produtos de qualidade acima das expectativas.

Se você se identifica com nosso negócio, #vemsercamaco!


Atribuições e responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver projetos de melhoria contínua em processos logísticos internos e externos.
  • Elaborar e revisar layouts de armazéns, centros de distribuição e áreas produtivas.
  • Analisar fluxos de materiais e propor soluções para redução de desperdícios.
  • Implementar sistemas e tecnologias para automação e rastreabilidade.
  • Coordenar estudos de capacidade, simulações e análises de viabilidade.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança e qualidade.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor planos de ação.
  • Liderar equipe técnica e dar suporte às áreas de operações e planejamento.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Superior completo ou cursando em Engenharia Produção, Logística, mecânica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Ter atuado em empresas do segmento automotivo;
  • Experiência na área de projetos logísticos, melhoria contínua ou planejamento;
  • Vivência com metodologias Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma e aplicação de Metodologia MTM;
  • Conhecimento em dimensionamento e gestão de recursos logísticos e phase-In/phase-out;
  • Atuação em layout fabril, fluxos de materiais, armazenagem e transporte;
  • Profissional com liderança e gestão de equipes, capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica;
  • Usuário de sistemas como AutoCAD, WMS, ERP, Excel avançado, Power BI;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Atibaia/SP.


O que temos pra você?

Assistência Médica e Odontológica;

Vale Alimentação;

Refeição no local;

Fretado ou VT

Seguro de Vida em grupo;

Clube de descontos.

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!
